rule: Holdings wording (owner rule, 22:25 GMT 30 Oct 2026): public text never states whether the family holds a record; it records which other party should hold the original and what each has disclosed. Build-time pass over the cedwyn copy (themes listed in skip_themes and the archived-capture prefixes are left verbatim), after every page writer in site.py and before the catalogue database is built. Exact phrases only; anything not matched is listed in dist/_cedwyn/reports/holdings-wording.json for an editor. P-104. — Sion's Tab agent
